hints.title: State Compression of Assigned Bikes
hints.text: The number of bikes is at most 10. A binary integer bitmask of length 10 compactly captures which bikes are currently assigned.

hints.title: Sequential Worker Assignment
hints.text: Assign bikes to workers in index order: worker 0, then worker 1, up to worker n - 1. When considering worker w, try every unassigned bike bit.

hints.title: Memoized Search
hints.text: Define subproblem as (worker_idx, bike_mask). Cache results to avoid recomputing identical bike allocation states across different assignment orderings.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all permutations without memoization explores M! paths (up to 3.6 million operations).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bitmask dynamic programming limits states to 10 * 1024, running within milliseconds.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize small constraints N, M <= 10 and apply bitmask DP.
complexity.notes: Each worker must be assigned a unique bike.
